visual_rule: black direct spatial panels; all sampled cells retained as dim tissue context; only primary medial450 cells are colored; LC core boundary overlaid
palette_rule: Fine26 colors are coherent within broad classes; broad classes use fixed semantic hues. Color is display identity only and does not encode confidence.
boundary: These maps show current Fine26 labels in the operational medial450 ROI. They do not imply that Fine26 boundaries are anatomical nuclei.
